notes: «فِی نَوَادِرِ اِبْنِ أَبِی عُمَيْرٍ» cites a book by its author: the author of a cited book is a needs-ruling case (rule 11); Ibn Abi Umayr is read as the first link only as the text's chain opening
«عَنْ بَعْضِ أَصْحَابِنَا» is an unnamed link (rule 1)
«عَنْ أَحَدِهِمَا» names neither Imam; left unnamed, as in t09-6187fe
